subject: Remote pay alignment framework: US / EU / APAC COLA multipliers and headcount exceptions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: CompBench <sales@compbench.co>
Date: Thu, 28 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Remote pay alignment framework: US / EU / APAC COLA multipliers and headcount exceptions

Team —

Attached is an updated proposal for remote pay differentials (COLA multipliers) across regions. CompBench helped produce the market benchmarks in COLA_matrix_v3.xlsx. High level asks:

- Approve recommended multipliers for APAC and EU for remote hires (sheet: "2027 multipliers").
- Approve a temporary headcount exception for 3 senior IC hires in APAC (Q1) to test the new multipliers.
- Confirm guardrails for director-level offers (max uplift percentage, approvals needed).

Quick notes: the APAC multipliers are higher than past internal guidance because of tightening talent markets in Singapore and Sydney; EU multipliers smooth between Nordic and Southern Europe bands to reduce offer churn. I want to pilot these for hires with start dates through end of Q2 and then evaluate budget impact.

Please review and reply with any redlines by end of day Feb 4. If you want a short sync instead, propose times and I will coordinate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: COLA_matrix_v3.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Remote pay alignment framework: US / EU / APAC COLA multipliers and headcount exceptions

On Thu, Jan 28, 2027 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Attached is an updated proposal for remote pay differentials...

Thanks Marissa — good work pulling this together. A few comments from my side after a quick pass through the matrix: 

1) APAC: I support the proposed senior IC multiplier for Singapore and Sydney but recommend raising the cap for senior-engineer offers by ~8% vs the base table (to reduce time-to-accept). That increases FY27 comp spend roughly $72k across the three pilots (see attached budget-impact-APAC.pdf).
2) EU: I like the smoothing approach, but we should keep a legal check on country-specific statutory requirements (particularly Sweden and Germany).
3) Directors: happy to allow exceptions up to 10% uplift on a case-by-case basis, but those must go through me + finance for signoff.

Next step: If you want to proceed with the APAC pilot, we need a formal headcount approval note to Finance (cc: accounting) and the recruiting team to lock offers. I'm looping in CompBench in case we want a final market sanity-check.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: budget-impact-APAC.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 31 Jan 2027 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Remote pay alignment framework: US / EU / APAC COLA multipliers and headcount exceptions

On Fri, Jan 29, 2027 at 11:07 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — good work pulling this together. A few comments...

Agree with Vivek on the APAC recommendation. Additional detail from comp bands side:

- For EU remote hires we should align to band codes E3–E5 to preserve internal parity; any uplift should be communicated as a temporary "market adjustment" rather than a permanent band change.
- Legal will want to review country-by-country. I will draft a short memo for Sweden/Germany/NL and share by Tue.
- Suggest a 5% discretionary EU uplift for candidate scenarios where retention risk > 0.7 (score from recruiting rubric).

If we proceed with the APAC pilot, recruiting should use the offer_template_remote.docx and mark the role as "pilot-COLA-APAC" in Workday / Greenhouse.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Compensation & Benefits Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: EU-band-note.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Feb 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Remote pay alignment framework: US / EU / APAC COLA multipliers and headcount exceptions

Thanks — quick decision from my side:

- Approve pilot for 3 senior IC hires in APAC with the multipliers in COLA_matrix_v3.xlsx.
- Approve a temporary 5% discretionary uplift for EU remote offers in close/at-risk scenarios as Laura suggested.
- Director exceptions: I approve up to 10% uplift but require Vivek + Finance signoff on any offer > 7%.

Please route the headcount approval to Finance today so recruiting can extend offers next week.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP, Engineering (Hiring Chair)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: CompBench <sales@compbench.co>, Anders Johansen <anders.j@benchmarks.eu>
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Remote pay alignment framework: US / EU / APAC COLA multipliers and headcount exceptions — final next steps

Folks — thanks for the quick turnaround and the approvals. Summary / actions: 

1) Approvals: APAC pilot (3 senior IC hires) approved; EU 5% discretionary uplift approved; Director exceptions up to 10% with finance signoff.
2) Recruiting: use offer_template_remote.docx and tag roles with "pilot-COLA-APAC". Recruiter owners to confirm target start dates and move offers by next Friday.
3) Finance: Marissa will send the headcount note + budget-impact-APAC.pdf to Finance for formal signoff (cc: Vivek).
4) Legal: Laura to share the country memo by Tue (Sweden/Germany/NL).
5) Follow-up evaluation: we will re-evaluate pilot impact on offer acceptance and comp spend at the end of Q2. CompBench to run a mid-pilot market check in May.

Links: Mutual action plan + docs -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqT-pilot-COLA-2027

If there are any changes to the multipliers after legal/finance review, do not extend offers until a final signoff is recorded.

I'll draft the headcount note to Finance and send it out this afternoon. Thanks again — moving to execution.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_template_remote.docx
